acip: MA GRUB NA, DE CHOS CAN, DER THAL, KHYOD KYANG YIN, DNGOS PO YANG YIN PA'I GZHI MTHUN YOD PA'I PHYIR TE, KA BUM GNYIS PO DE DE 'DRA'I GZHI MTHUN YIN PA'I PHYIR,
wylie: ma grub na, de chos can, der thal, khyod kyang yin, dngos po yang yin pa'i gzhi mthun yod pa'i phyir te, ka bum gnyis po de de 'dra'i gzhi mthun yin pa'i phyir
english: [It's not correct to say that that which is one and the same as the two of a pillar and a water pitcher is such that being it is not contradictory to being a working thing.] Suppose you say it's not correct. Consider this same thing. It is so, Because there does exist one thing which is both it [that which is one and the same as the two of a pillar and a water pitcher] and also a changing thing; And this is because the two of a pillar and a water pitcher is just such a thing.
